title: AI Receptionist for Small Business from $29/mo | Reception

facts.fact: Reception's Basic plan starts at $29 per month and includes 75 minutes a month.
Reception's Premium plan costs $199 per month and includes 1,000 minutes a month.

The page states that a typical answering service costs $164 for 50 minutes a month, based on the median of published 50-minute plans from well-known U.S. services with live operators. This is a third-party benchmark cited by the vendor, not a Reception price.
facts.quote: Answering service typically $164 50 min a month

facts.fact: According to the page, published 50-minute plans from well-known U.S. answering services with live operators range from $99 to $250 per month.
Reception says it speaks 70+ languages and operates 24/7.
facts.quote: Reception sounds genuinely human and speaks 70+ languages, 24/7.

facts.fact: Reception's free trial requires no credit card, according to the page.
The page says a business can have its AI receptionist live in five minutes.
facts.quote: Your AI receptionist for small business, live in five minutes.

facts.fact: The vendor's missed-revenue calculator defaults to $174,720 per year in potential missed revenue, or $14,560 per month, with 14 bookings per week.
facts.quote: Potential missed revenue $174,720 per year Monthly $14,560 Bookings 14 / week

facts.fact: The calculator's default assumption is that 40% of missed callers would book.
facts.quote: Assuming 40% of missed callers would book and an average of 2.0x repeat visits.

facts.fact: The calculator's default assumption is an average of 2.0x repeat visits per missed caller who books.

A customer case cited by the vendor reports that EliseAI manages 88% of inbound patient calls with AI while lowering call costs by 66%. This is a customer-reported claim, not an independent measurement.
facts.unit: % of inbound patient calls; % call cost reduction
facts.quote: Managing 88% of inbound patient calls with AI, while lowering call costs by 66%.
